title: Start here
blurb: New to all of this? These terms give you a solid foundation.
reflection: Which of these words felt new, and which felt familiar? Write one question you want to explore next.

title: Talking it through
blurb: How to bring up ideas, set boundaries and stay in sync with a partner.
reflection: Think of one boundary and one desire you could share with a partner. How would you phrase each?

title: Understanding roles
blurb: Who does what, and why 'dominant' and 'top' aren't the same thing.
reflection: Which roles feel interesting, and which do not? Remember that roles can change over time.

title: Gentle ways to explore
blurb: Lower-intensity activities many people begin with.
reflection: Pick one idea you would like to talk through with a partner. What would make it feel safe?

title: Finding your people
blurb: What to expect when you're ready to meet others.
reflection: What would you want to know before attending your first event?

title: Safety first
blurb: Consent in depth, limits, and what to do if something goes wrong.
reflection: Write down your own hard limits and soft limits. Which would you share, and with whom?

title: Feelings and aftercare
blurb: The emotional side of play, from subspace to drop and how to care for each other.
reflection: What helps you feel grounded after an intense experience? Share it with a partner before you need it.

title: Meeting people safely
blurb: Practical habits for events, first meetings and finding good mentors.
reflection: Which safety habit from this path will you adopt first?

title: Impact play basics
blurb: What impact play is, the common tools, and where to be careful.
reflection: What sensations do you enjoy, and what do you want to avoid? Put it in your negotiation notes.

title: Rope and restraints
blurb: Restraint fundamentals with a strong emphasis on safety gear.
reflection: Where could you take an in-person class to learn this properly?

title: Power dynamics, deeper
blurb: How D/s relationships are designed, negotiated and reviewed.
reflection: If you designed a dynamic, what would you want to review every month?

title: Beyond monogamy
blurb: Relationship structures where more than two people may be involved.
reflection: What agreements would help everyone feel secure and respected?
